svg.title: Figure 3 — Swin-Tiny classifier architecture
svg.text: Figure 3 | Swin-Tiny phase classifier — network architecture
one 256 × 256 segmented particle crop in, three crystallographic phase scores out
swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224 · ImageNet-1k pretrained · 27.5 M parameters · slab thickness ∝ channel width, face height ∝ token-grid size
Attention is confined to 7 × 7 windows; the window grid shifts by 3 between consecutive blocks, which is what lets information cross window boundaries.
